requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: The original requirement combines a functional action (informing the security service) with a quality attribute (response time within 2s). Per Pohl (2025) §25.2, this concern-mixing issue requires decomposition into a functional requirement and a quality requirement.

source_fragments: The system shall inform the security service
structured_requirements.final_statement: The system shall inform the security service after detecting damage.
structuring_notes: Extracted functional behavior from the original sentence, preserving the event trigger and target actor.

structured_requirements.final_statement: The system shall respond within 2 s.
structuring_notes: Extracted the temporal quality attribute as a separate requirement to ensure clear measurability and separation of concerns.
